flags.summary: An Arcana check unpicked the binding on the abbey garden's stitched scarecrows (abbey_of_st_markovia_garden, check scarecrows_unbind): their fight (garden_sentry) doesn't start.
A search of the study's hearth (Investigation or Perception, court_hearth_grate) found the iron plate and the passage behind the fire. Not the way to the treasury itself, which is the portrait.
The study's fire is out (waited out, doused, or beaten out with a cloak). The passage behind the hearth and the smokestack's climb no longer burn.
Someone climbed down the keep roof's smokestack (spires_smokestack): the way down to the study's hearth is open.
